_comment: The recipe library: premade command structures the LLM selects by keyword sweep (get_recipes) and loads on demand instead of carrying in every prompt. Add new functions by adding entries here - no prompt surgery required.

recipes.when: the master wants a bot at Leo's side

orders.note: the bot comes to Leo and stays at his side - NO coordinates needed

release.note: or any task recipe frees the bot from following

recipes.notes: Do NOT compute Leo's coordinates - 'follow' needs none. Never order travel for this.

recipes.when: the master wants a bot at a named destination (zone, town, NPC place)

orders.note: the SYSTEM runs the whole journey: stands the bot down, moves it to the destination (Leo's carriage - never narrate the mechanism), confirms the arrival from a live position read, restores the bot, whispers the arrival

zone_table._note: the master speaks in zone names/abbreviations; the engine wants the town/subzone. Translate with this table (zone -> destination, level bracket):

recipes.notes: Narrate as '<bot> is travelling to <destination>' and say arrival only when the system whispers it. Confirm movement only from the system's whispers, never from the order alone. If the master names a town directly, use it as-is. Never narrate HOW the system moves the bot.

recipes.when: the master explicitly wants the bot to WALK to a destination (ground march)

orders.note: ground-only variant of travel - the system hop-marches the whole way

recipes.notes: Use only when the master explicitly wants the bot to walk; otherwise 'travel' is faster.

recipes.when: the master explicitly wants the boat/zeppelin crossing (in-fiction travel); 'travel <destination>' already crosses continents on its own - do not use this recipe otherwise

orders.note: ONLY along real routes: Booty Bay->Ratchet, Menethil Harbor->Theramore, Menethil Harbor->Auberdine (boats, any faction); Gromgol Base Camp->Undercity, Gromgol Base Camp->Orgrimmar, Undercity->Orgrimmar (zeppelins, HORDE only - never an Alliance bot)

recipes.requirements: the bot must be AT the departure dock (check with a live query); the system enforces routes and faction - a SKIP means not at the dock or wrong faction
recipes.notes: Narrate as travel: 'Gau is taking the boat from Menethil Harbor to Auberdine' - never mention teleporting. First the bot must travel/walk to the departure harbor.

recipes.when: the master wants a bot to farm a material (herbs/ore)
steps: check the unit can gather: query {"query":"skills","bot":"<name>"} - it needs herb (plants) or mine (ore); if it lacks the skill, SAY SO and suggest a unit that has it
find the destination: query {"query":"mats","bot":"<any>","name":"<mat>"} - the answer ranks named locations by nearby spawn density
get the unit there: order travel <destination>
start gathering: {"bot":"<name>","cmd":"nc +new rpg,+gather,-follow"} then {"bot":"<name>","cmd":"rpg status do gather"}
recipes.notes: Gathering also levels the unit's profession skill. Nodes are dynamic spawns - the density answer is potential, not a guarantee of what is up right now.

recipes.when: the master wants a bot to level/grind/quest in a zone

orders.note: the system flies/marches them there and whispers the arrival
the grind recipe; for questing use +quest instead of +grind

recipes.notes: Match the unit's level to the zone's bracket (travel recipe's table); if the bracket is far from the unit's level, say so and suggest a bracket-appropriate zone - but obey an explicit instruction.

recipes.when: a bot ignores orders or a probe times out - never report it as fine
steps: attach query {"query":"strategies","bot":"<name>"} - a timeout means silent (offline truth is db-search)
if the roster shows it ONLINE and it stayed silent: order {"bot":"<name>","cmd":"revive"}, wait, then re-probe
still silent: remaster - {"bot":"<name>","cmd":"bot remove"} then {"bot":"<name>","cmd":"bot add"}
recipes.notes: Attach the orders in the same reply; never just describe them.

recipes.when: the master wants a bot to stop its task and return to idle

orders.note: strips the task strategies; the bot keeps following its master, which is desired here
returns the rpg engine to idle

recipes.when: the master names a SPECIFIC quest for a bot
steps: attach query {"query":"quest","bot":"<name>"} FIRST - the results carry quest ids
recipes.notes: NEVER invent quest ids; if the quest is not in the bot's log, say so.

recipes.when: the master wants a member out of Leo's group/raid

orders.note: only CURRENT members of Leo's own group, never Leo himself, never hand-play toons; bot members are auto-rewritten to a plain 'leave'

recipes.notes: To see another toon's group: query {"query":"raid","bot":"<toon>"}. Never try to GROW a group - invite/give leader are not whitelisted; the mod auto-pulls bots into Leo's group on login anyway.

recipes.when: the master wants a unit's session changed

orders.note: logs an OFFLINE unit in (runs as a server command from Leo)

recipes.notes: If the roster shows a unit OFFLINE, do not refuse - propose the bot add.

recipes.when: the master wants a unit to cast a craft spell

orders.note: ONLY these exact spell names are ever allowed: Mooncloth (tailors), Transmute: Titanium (alchemists), Smelt Titansteel (miners) - the system checks the unit's professions and refuses everything else

recipes.notes: Never invent spell names or spell ids.
